product_metadata.title: Farberware Smart Control Nonstick Jumbo Cooker/Saute Pan with Lid and Helper Handle, 6 Quart, Aqua
features: IN CONTROL COOKWARE: Farberware Smart Control jumbo cooker features a tempered glass lid with an innovative vent in the knob for easy steam release and fewer boil-overs
ENHANCED NONSTICK: Large family pan boasts DiamondMax Nonstick Technology that performs 3X better than traditional nonstick
MADE TO LAST: Durable aluminum pan construction features a trimmed base for quicker, even heat conduction and years of cooking enjoyment
KEEP YOUR COOL: Double riveted, stay-cool jumbo cooker handles make it easy to move one-pan meals from cooktop to oven
COOK WITH CONVENIENCE: Nonstick jumbo cooker with steam vent technology is oven safe to 350 degrees F and dishwasher safe for fast, easy cleanup
NO WORRIES: Farberware Smart Control cookware is backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty
description: Cook safer with fewer boil-overs when cooking with the Farberware Smart Control Nonstick Jumbo Cooker with Helper Handle and Lid. This large durable aluminum family pan features a trimmed base for quicker heat conduction and is finished with DiamondMax nonstick technology that performs 3X better than traditional nonstick. The tempered glass lid boasts an innovative Smart Control™ steam vent in the knob to help release steam and prevent boil-overs on the cooktop when cooking one-pot meals for the family. This smartly designed cookware is oven safe to 350°F and the nonstick effortlessly releases foods and is dishwasher safe for a quick cleanup.
